visual_brief.subject: AgentServe targets delays when several agents share one GPU
verified_context: AgentServe separates prompt processing and output generation on one GPU and adjusts resource allocation as demand changes.
The authors test small language models under concurrent agent workloads; the reported speedups are not a general guarantee.
visual_brief.editorial_idea: Separating bulky input work from small output steps can reduce interference, without implying perfect isolation or measured speed.
visual_brief.visual_metaphor: Large terracotta slabs and small pale tiles occupy separate channels within one sculptural stone structure, an abstract workload separation metaphor.
must_show: central focal forms that survive cover cropping

candidate_notes.A: Selected: two stacked channels make the difference between bulky input work and small output steps clear; pale stone and terracotta maintain archive continuity.
candidate_notes.B: Viable monumental split-channel metaphor, but the outdoor landscape adds detail unrelated to the workload and weakens reference continuity.
candidate_notes.C: Viable curved-channel study with clear size contrast; the low view flattens the separation slightly compared with A.

crop_review.article_desktop: 1200 x 514 centered 21:9 crop inspected. Desktop crop clips the top of a nonessential slab; both channels remain clear. Square crop trims lateral ends while retaining large slabs above small tiles.
crop_review.article_mobile: 359 x 202 centered 16:9 crop inspected; focal forms remain visible.
crop_review.thumbnail: 320 x 164 centered cover crop inspected; focal silhouette remains distinct.
crop_review.home_square: 260 x 260 centered square preview inspected; nonessential edges crop as noted above.

golden_reference_comparison: The pale architectural section, restrained terracotta, fine supporting arcs and warm grain belong beside the two references. Candidate A has a simpler mechanism and stronger vertical hierarchy; it is a metaphor for resource separation, not a measured GPU diagram.
contact_sheet_renderer: Pillow fallback with two golden references above three candidates. Canonical contact-sheet CLI was attempted and could not launch the missing Playwright Chromium. The official browser download had already failed with a truncated/non-ZIP payload during the previous batch; it was not retried. No repository code or validator was changed.

generation_metadata.review_type: Codex model visual self-review; no human sign-off
